# Navegación Checklist: Navegación y superficies (SPEC-031)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing. Valida la calidad, claridad y completitud de los requisitos de navegación por superficies, contexto de empresa y ejercicio, y favoritos por usuario, antes de pasar a `/speckit.plan`.
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the six surfaces named together with the complete membership of each one, so that the requirement that every screen be reachable can be evaluated without inventing the list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008 and §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec identify which screen is the landing screen of each surface, given that it requires one per surface and only one exists today? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Are the creation actions of each surface enumerated, or does the spec only state that they must not be navigation destinations? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec enumerate the duplicated addresses that must be consolidated, so that the requirement of a single current location is verifiable? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Are the contents required in the context zone specified per element, including what identifies the user and what identifies each selection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the expression of visually distinguishing the exercise states quantified by the property that distinguishes them, or is it left to the visual design? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK007 Is the expression of the current exercise defined by an explicit rule, or are current and previous exercise distinguishable only by reading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK008 Is the maximum number of favourites stated in the requirement, or does the requirement say only that the number is limited? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK009 Is the expression of not exceeding the number of destinations of a bottom bar quantified in the requirement itself? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Is the criterion of the minimum permission expressed as a property of the user, and is that indirection acceptable for a requirement that must be testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is the list of acronyms excluded as sole naming specified, or is FR-015 only a criterion without an enumeration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 Are surface, destination and option defined as three distinct terms, given that the spec uses all three without separating them? [Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Does the maximum number of favourites in the requirement agree with the number stated in the success criterion? [Conflict, Spec §FR-025 against §SC-007]
- [x] CHK014 Is the state shown when the two exercise state sources disagree specified consistently with the rule that prevails the most restrictive state? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016 against §FR-019]
- [x] CHK015 Do the requirement that the order of the main destinations is independent of use and the requirement that favourites do not alter that order express compatible obligations, or are they redundant in a way that may later diverge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009 against §FR-023]
- [x] CHK016 Do the three first-priority stories remain independently deliverable given that a requirement blocks every business option without an identified session? [Consistency, Spec §US1 and §US2 against §FR-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can the criterion of finding an option in two movements in ninety per cent of the options be measured objectively without a defined measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Is the criterion of the context zone being visible on every business screen expressed as an exhaustive verification, or as a sample? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK019 Is the criterion of detecting an unassigned screen in less than one working day a statement about the product or about the process, and is it verifiable as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK020 Are all success criteria free of references to implementation, and do any of them assert internal state rather than a user-visible outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 to §SC-012]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the exception path when the context query fails and neither company nor exercise can be resolved? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the recovery path when the session expires while the user is completing an entry? [Gap, Recovery Flow]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the alternate path of a user with access to a single company, where the company selector has nothing to switch to? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the primary path of entering a surface, listing its options and acting on one of them, beyond the summary requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are the boundary conditions of the favourites limit addressed at zero, at exactly the limit, and above the limit? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK026 Is the display of the number of entries defined for an exercise that does not exist yet? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK027 Is the layout of the navigation defined for a user who cannot access any option of a surface, so that no broken destination remains visible? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK028 Is the case of a new canonical location that collides with an existing one addressed, given that the program already has pairs of equivalent addresses? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are keyboard navigation requirements specified for the main destinations, the surface panel and the company and exercise selectors? [Gap, Coverage]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements specified so that the state of the exercise is not conveyed by colour alone, given that four states must be distinguished visually? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK031 Is a visible focus requirement specified for the focusable elements of the navigation? [Gap, Coverage]
- [x] CHK032 Are accessibility requirements specified for the small-screen element that carries the company and exercise selection? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK033 Are performance requirements quantified for changing company or exercise, given that this change is the most frequent action of the feature? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK034 Is the assumption of reusing the identity and permission model without changes documented together with its consequence for the requirement that resolves the context? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions against §FR-006]
- [x] CHK035 Is the dependency on the information that tells which options the user may open documented, which is what allows a favourite to be hidden without being deleted? [Dependency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK036 Is the dependency on the two existing sources of exercise state documented at the point where the spec reconciles them? [Dependency, Spec §FR-019]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK037 Is the disagreement between the two exercise state sources identified as resolved in the requirements, or only in the assumptions? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019 against §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Are the three ambiguities recorded in checklists/requirements.md intended to remain open for the plan, and is that intention stated in the spec itself? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011 and §FR-015]
- [x] CHK039 Is the absence of accessibility and performance requirements declared as an accepted gap, given that the feature is motivated by a design system that includes both, or is it an unnoticed omission? [Gap]
- [x] CHK040 Does the requirement that blocks access without an identified session explicitly avoid extending the permission model, given that the security topics are deferred to a later feature? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001 against §Assumptions]

## Notas

### Revision de requisitos (2026-09-27, previa a la implementacion)

Los 40 items se revisaron uno a uno contra `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md`,
`data-model.md`, `contracts/` y `quickstart.md`. Resultado: **28 ya estaban
satisfechos** y **12 seguian abiertos**, que se corrigieron antes de marcar nada.

**12 items cerrados por correccion del spec:**

| Item | Que estaba mal | Correccion |
|---|---|---|
| CHK009 | FR-011 no cuantificaba el numero de destinos | redactado como 4 destinos mas «Mas» |
| CHK012 | «opcion» se usaba sin definir junto a superficie y destino | aclarado que una opcion **es** un destino |
| CHK016 | Las 3 historias P1 declaraban ser independientes, pero FR-001 bloquea sin sesion | cada una declara que requiere US1 |
| CHK017 | SC-002 sin metodo de medicion | metodo fijado sobre la taxonomia finita del mapa |
| CHK019 | SC-011 mezclaba producto y proceso («menos de un dia») | reescrito como comprobacion automatica en toda la suite |
| CHK020 | SC-011 con sabor a proceso, SC-013 con clausula de fixture | ambas reescritas; el volumen sale del SC y vive en T069 |
| CHK021 | Sin requisitos para el fallo de la consulta de contexto | caso borde anadido: comunicar e impedir el registro |
| CHK022 | Sin recuperacion ante sesion caducada a media entrada | caso borde anadido: conservar lo introducido |
| CHK023 | Sin camino alterno para usuario de una sola empresa | caso borde anadido: selector visible y sin opciones |
| CHK025 | **Contradiccion real entre artefactos** | ver abajo |
| CHK027 | Sin definicion para el usuario sin ninguna superficie | caso borde anadido: retirar destinos e indicar |
| CHK038 | La intencion de delegar FR-006/011/015 al plan vivia solo en `requirements.md` | supuesto anadido al spec que lo declara |

**6 items ya los habia cerrado la remediacion de `/speckit.analyze`:** CHK008 y CHK013
(FR-025 ya dice «maximo de 5»), CHK029 y CHK031 (ahora FR-030 y FR-031), CHK030 (FR-031
prohibe el color solo) y CHK033 y CHK039 (SC-013 y T069).

**CHK025 era la contradiccion mas grave de las doce.** Cuatro artefactos describian
comportamientos incompatibles para la misma condicion: el caso borde del spec y
`research.md` decian que un favorito por encima del maximo **se recorta y se guarda**,
mientras el contrato y T037 decian **422**. Los cuatro artefactos se han puesto de acuerdo
en el comportamiento correcto:

- El limite de FR-025 opera **en la lectura, no en la escritura**. Un sexto favorito se
  guarda y la lectura recorta a 5 informando `total` y `visibles`.
- El 422 `orden_fuera_de_rango` queda solo para un `orden` no positivo, que es otra cosa.
- El caso borde del spec exige ahora que el favorito oculto **no se pierda** y reaparezca
  si el usuario desmarca otro.

Rechazar en la escritura habria dejado al usuario con 5 favoritos sin poder anadir el suyo,
que es justo lo que el requisito prohibe. El error era nuestro, no del spec, y lo detecto la
revision del checklist, no el paso de analisis.

**Lo que NO se cerro, y sigue abierto por decision:** que 4 de los 6 destinos van a la barra
inferior de movil es una decision de producto que este checklist no puede resolver. Consta
como supuesto explicito en `spec.md` para que no se pierda.

### Notas de operacion

- Mark items \`[x]\` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- \`/speckit.implement\` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- \`checklists/requirements.md\` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by \`/speckit.specify\` and \`/speckit.clarify\`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

**Contexto usado para generar el checklist**

| Decisión | Valor | Efecto en el contenido |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 · Dimensiones ausentes | A | Se incluyen accesibilidad y rendimiento como secciones de huecos, aunque el spec no las mencione |
| Q2 · Profundidad | A (estándar) | 40 ítems repartidos en las 9 dimensiones de calidad |
| Q3 · Frontera con SPEC-032 | A | La sección de ambigüedades incluye la comprobación de que FR-001 no amplía el modelo de permisos |

**Documentos disponibles al generar**: solo `spec.md`. No existen `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md` ni `contracts/`, porque la feature está recién salida de `/speckit.specify`. Los ítems que apuntan a detalles técnicos delegables al plan (permiso concreto, número de destinos de la barra inferior, enumeración de siglas) se marcan como ambigüedad conocida, no como defecto.

**Desviación del procedimiento**: `check-prerequisites.ps1 -Json -Template checklist-template` no se pudo usar porque el script exige `plan.md` en toda llamada que no sea `-PathsOnly` (línea 104 del script), y el plan todavía no existe. Se resolvió el directorio de la feature con `-PathsOnly` y la plantilla con `resolve-template.ps1 -TemplateName checklist-template`, que es el mismo stack de resolución que usa el script. El resultado es idéntico al que habría devuelto el script cuando exista el plan.
